task: Cycling-lth: pre-load and post-output context of candidate high-power segments in Sunday group rides
reference_ftp_source: D:/Cycling/icu/coach_memory/athlete_snapshot.json ftp_set (read-only); descriptive bins only, not a measured physiological threshold

methods.bout_rule_reused: From crazies-demands.json, unchanged: centered 5s moving average >= threshold (360W=1.2x ref, 450W=1.5x ref), contiguous >=5s, bridge <=3 below-threshold seconds only within uninterrupted 1Hz recording, keep only bouts with raw mean >= threshold. Boundaries approx +/-2s. Each reused bout raw mean re-verified against stream (all pass).
methods.candidate_cluster: 360W bouts separated by <=10 s of continuous 1 Hz recording are merged into one candidate cluster (components and merged gaps listed). 450W bouts are mapped to the containing 360W cluster (none orphaned). Clusters 11-60 s apart are NOT merged but flagged via previous_cluster.within_adjacency_flag_60s; merge-threshold sensitivity (0/10/30/60 s) given per activity. Clusters are candidate high-power segments, NOT user-confirmed attacks.
methods.cluster_power: mean_watts_raw = mean of all raw samples in cluster span incl. merged dips (no threshold-only sampling). best_5s/best_10s rolling within cluster.
methods.salience_ranking: Top-5 per activity among main-proxy clusters ranked by salience_J_above_ref_ftp = sum(max(0, P-300W)) over cluster seconds. Descriptive ranking only; not W-prime or anaerobic energy.
methods.mechanical_work: kJ = sum(watts of recorded 1 Hz samples) / 1000, i.e. W*1s/1000. Whole-ride sum equals API icu_joules for all 8 activities. Mechanical work, not glycogen or anaerobic energy.
methods.windows: Pre windows [t0-W, t0) and post windows [t1, t1+W) in elapsed (real) time; t0 = cluster first sample elapsed, t1 = last sample elapsed + 1 (exclusive end). Only recorded samples used; pause/missing seconds reported as missing_or_pause_s and coverage = valid samples / window seconds; never zero-filled, never stitched across pauses. Real zero watts kept. Pre window starting before activity start -> NA; post window beyond recording end -> NA. coverage<0.9 flagged and excluded from within-activity comparison.
methods.hr: Mean of non-null HR > 0 samples in window; hr_samples given.
methods.previous_cluster_gap: Elapsed seconds from previous cluster end (exclusive) to this start; gap_mean_watts over recorded samples. Gap is not evidence of sufficient recovery.
methods.within_activity_comparison: Per activity only: main-proxy clusters with 30-min pre-window coverage>=0.9, split at median pre-30-min work; medians + Spearman rho (pre30 work vs best5s; cumulative work vs best5s). Not pooled across days.
methods.course_anchor: Clusters whose start distance (device distance stream) falls in fixed km ranges recurring across complete Sundays. Altitude change is device altitude, approximate. Location identity is inferred from distance only (no GPS latlng in files) [inference].
methods.identity: Only 2026-08-23 title names Crazies; other Sundays = related Sunday samples per user weekly-attendance statement. 2026-10-04 truncated, separate. 2026-10-08 Thursday, separate.

cannot_infer: Which candidate was a user-initiated attack vs following/closing a gap vs climb pacing (needs user labels).

Whether/when the user was dropped: no drop-event timestamps exist; post-candidate power drop cannot by itself indicate dropping (several top candidates end within 1-5 s of main-proxy end, i.e. end of the group portion).
Was any candidate a maximal effort (intent unknown).
Causal magnitude of fatigue on peak output; physiological weakness; CP/W-prime depletion; future FTP floor or genetic ceiling.
Between-day differences as training adaptation (heat, tactics, group composition and intent differ).
